title: One Last Ring
story: It's Christmas Eve. Every chime is back where it belongs, and Nutmeg carefully rings the reassembled Bell one final time — it sings out clear and golden, and the whole workshop holds its breath. One last trial stands between you and watching Santa's sleigh lift into the sky.
question: Christmas Eve traditionally marks the end of Advent and the start of which 12-day festive season that runs until Epiphany?
